title: Soft Deletes vs. Hard Deletes: Architecture and Query Traps
realWorldScenario: An engineering team implements soft deletes by adding `is_deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT false` to every table.
questionStatement: What are the advantages of soft deletes? What query traps, index bloat, and UNIQUE constraint complications do soft deletes introduce?
expectedConcepts: Soft delete definition and audit advantages
Leaked deleted records in un-filtered queries
hints: What happens if a user soft-deletes their account and later tries to register again with the same email?
